hypothesis: Official SwinIR-S x2 reproduces Set5 mean PSNR-Y 38.14 dB within 0.02 dB on this fixed CPU environment.
baseline: Official SwinIR-S x2 DIV2K pretrained weights; source 6545850fbf8df298df73d81f3e8cba638787c8bd; reference Table 3, arXiv:2108.10257v1. This is reproduction, not global SOTA improvement.
controlled_variables: Exactly baby/bird/butterfly/head/woman and official x2 LR pairs; asset hashes frozen
CPU float32, four threads, fixed official lightweight architecture and weights
Official mirror padding, BGR/RGB conversions, uint8 rounding, crop border 2, Y-channel metrics
No model selection, training, self-ensemble, tiling, test-driven adjustments, or automatic retries
validity_checks: All five frozen image pairs evaluated
Frozen assets and metric code unchanged
No training, tuning, or model changes

outcomes.go: The baseline pipeline is usable; plan one separately preregistered improvement study with distinct development and held-out data.
outcomes.stop: Stop this reproduction route; do not change the metric, model or tolerance to rescue the result.
outcomes.invalid: No scientific conclusion: log the precise prespecified validity/operational failure before considering a new measurement protocol.

cost_assumptions.compute_usd_per_hour: Local accounting proxy of USD 1 per allocated machine-hour, not an external invoice.
unpriced: Hardware depreciation and electricity are not measured
Acquisition/setup time was not fully metered
Storage after the run is not included
cost_assumptions.retention: Keep source, weights, environment and artifacts locally until reviewed; actual disk footprint reported separately
